author: ImJustXenon
quote: Bad game, horrible pacing, a girlfriend simulator in the purest sense. This is supposed to be a Grand Theft Auto game, a series known for player freedom and over-the-top crime. This game is front loaded with chores, there are unkillable/protected NPC’s, you cannot steal vehicles within your own neighborhood. They tried to make Read Dead 3, and the game is significantly worse for it. They want to encourage empathy. Realism doesn’t make what is supposed to be a free and funny crime simulator better, it makes it dull.
